# OpenSearch Dashboards Service

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `docker.opensearch-dashboards.service` |
| Source | `09_docker/docker.opensearch-dashboards.service.yaml` |
| Tags | docker, search |

OpenSearch Dashboards UI fronting the local OpenSearch cluster. Security dashboards
plugin is disabled to match the dev-mode OpenSearch node.
